title: More than half of adults in U.S. say they lack basic statistical understanding
summary: Penn State researchers found that over half of US adults self-report lacking basic statistical understanding, indicating a significant gap in quantitative literacy that affects people's ability to interpret data and make informed decisions in daily life.
problem_solved: Identifies the widespread statistical literacy deficiency among American adults.
why_valuable: Highlights a critical educational gap that impacts decision-making across healthcare, finance, and civic engagement.
